title: Delegation Without Trust: An Empirical Gap Analysis of Identity, Authorization, and Runtime Governance in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
topic_quote: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly act on a user's behalf: they hold credentials, call tools and services, and spawn sub-agents.
contact_route_quote: Panduranga Sai Varma Dantuluri — Affiliation: VotalAI — Email: sai@votal.ai

relevance_note: Empirical research on multi-agent LLM delegation, identity, authorization and runtime governance. It directly studies how autonomous agents delegate authority to sub-agents and evaluates security mechanisms for agent-to-agent operation, making it a close fit for research on multi-agent systems, agent identity and interoperable autonomous-agent infrastructure.
